intents.response: Hello! I am CampusAssist, your college information assistant. How can I help you today?
Goodbye! Have a great day. Feel free to ask anytime you need help.

patterns: Where can I find the library?
How do I get a library card?
intents.response: The college library is located on the ground floor of the main academic building. It is open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days. Students can get a library card by submitting a passport-size photo and their student ID at the library counter.

patterns: What documents are needed for admission?
intents.response: Admissions are conducted once a year, typically in June-July. You need to fill out the online application form on the college website and submit documents including mark sheets, ID proof, and passport-size photos. For detailed eligibility criteria, visit the admissions office on the first floor of the admin block.

patterns: How much is the tuition fee?
Tell me about the fee structure
What is the fee for engineering?
How can I pay the fees?
intents.response: The annual tuition fee varies by program. For undergraduate programs it is approximately Rs. 75,000 per year. Fees can be paid online through the student portal or at the accounts office. Fee concessions and scholarships are available for eligible students based on merit and financial need.

patterns: Tell me about the exam schedule
Where can I find the exam timetable?
intents.response: The college follows a semester-based examination system. Internal exams are held mid-semester and external exams at the end of each semester. The exam timetable is published on the college notice board and website two weeks before exams. The minimum passing marks are 40% in each subject.

patterns: What happens if I have low attendance?
intents.response: A minimum of 75% attendance is required in each subject to be eligible for the semester examination. Attendance is tracked through daily roll calls. Students with attendance below 75% may be detained and not allowed to sit for exams. Medical leave with valid documentation can be considered.

patterns: How many departments does the college have?
intents.response: The college has the following departments: Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Information Technology. Each department has dedicated labs, faculty, and a departmental library.

patterns: Is there any fest coming up?
intents.response: The college organizes an annual technical fest 'TechVista' in February and a cultural fest 'Euphoria' in March. Various departmental events, workshops, and guest lectures are held throughout the year. Follow the college notice board and social media pages for the latest updates.

patterns: How can I register for placements?
intents.response: The college has an active Training and Placement Cell that coordinates campus recruitment. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Cognizant regularly visit for placements. Students can register for placements through the placement cell office on the second floor of the admin block. The average placement rate is around 80%.

patterns: How much is the hostel fee?
How do I apply for hostel?
intents.response: The college provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls within the campus. Hostel fee is approximately Rs. 40,000 per year including mess charges. Hostel rooms are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis. Facilities include Wi-Fi, a common room, and 24-hour security. Apply at the hostel office during admission.

patterns: What food is available in the canteen?
Where can I eat on campus?
intents.response: The college canteen is located near the main ground, opposite the auditorium. It is open from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM and serves breakfast, lunch, and snacks at affordable prices. A separate mess facility is available for hostel students.

patterns: How can I contact the college?
What is the college phone number?
How can I contact the placement cell?
intents.response: You can contact the college at phone: 011-2345-6789 or email: info@democollege.edu.in. The administration office is open from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM on working days. For placement queries, email: placements@democollege.edu.in.
College hours are from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday to Friday, and 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM on Saturdays. Each lecture is 50 minutes long with a lunch break from 12:30 PM to 1:15 PM.

The college offers undergraduate programs including B.Tech (4 years) and BCA (3 years), as well as postgraduate programs including M.Tech (2 years) and MCA (2 years). Each program follows the curriculum prescribed by the affiliated university. Detailed syllabus is available on the college website.
